phases.detail: Consumed the 2026-09-09T20:35:30Z Copilot review first. Its two published findings showed that npm configuration could redirect approved registry URLs and that a version-1 shrinkwrap could smuggle its consumed dependencies tree behind a harmless packages object.

Added focused regression coverage.
